lines.speaker: june
lines.text: What came before the Big Bang?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: What's north of the North Pole?

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: What? Nothing. That's the top of Earth.

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Right. You can't go further north.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Okay, but what does that have to do with time?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: Maybe asking what came before time is the same question.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: Wait, so there might not even be a before?

lines.speaker: milo
lines.text: The universe didn't begin in time.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: So how can something begin if there was no before?
